Definition: bitter (literally or figuratively); also (as noun) bitterness, or (adverbially) bitterly
BiblicalUsage: adj; 1) bitter, bitterness; 1a) of water or food; 1b) of harlot's end, end of wickedness, cry (fig.); 1c) of pain (subst); adv; 2) bitterly
